$comment: This /.well-known/agent-skills/ HTTP discovery path is a SRIFT convention (proposed), NOT part of the published Agent Skills specification (agentskills.io defines only a directory format, with no standardized HTTP discovery mechanism). The Skills-over-MCP Working Group lists a well-known discovery URI as an open, in-scope design question; SRIFT also serves these same 4 skills over MCP itself via skills/list + skills/get + resources/read (skill:// URIs, SEP-2640 'Skills Extension', io.modelcontextprotocol/skills), which IS a ratified extension of the Model Context Protocol.

skills.name: get-company-info
skills.description: Retrieve overview and core metadata for SRIFT and SRIPTO Corporation

skills.name: quick-share
skills.description: Zero-install file delivery: seed a file and get a public download URL, no session setup required on the recipient's end

skills.name: session-management
skills.description: Create, join, monitor, and control SRIFT end-to-end encrypted P2P sessions via the local MCP daemon

skills.name: encrypted-chat
skills.description: Send and read end-to-end encrypted chat messages and manage in-session file transfers within an active SRIFT session
